title: Private seeded per-worktree cargo targets replace the shared target
goal: Retire the shared 253 GiB cargo target: every worktree gets a private target seeded by copy from a snapshot (scripts/seed-target.sh), linked worktrees convert on hooks, target-guard.sh/link-shared-target.sh stay as shims for installed v0.21.23, and parallel_workflow's children get a whole home via isolate_home
